cache.coldTitle: Prompt cache is cold — the 1h TTL expired; the next turn will be a full cache miss
cache.warmTitle: Prompt cache is warm — cools in {{remaining}} (1h TTL)

context.accurateTitle: Exact count: the composed request is counted on the server with the provider's actual tokenizer (count_tokens; Anthropic only, no generation — one free API call). The deviation from the heuristic estimate appears in the Token summary.
context.cliMeasured: Estimate {{estimated}} → actual context — chat {{actual}} (+{{overhead}} overhead{{ratio}}, {{calls}} call avg.)
context.cliNoteMeasured: {{provider}} adds its own system prompt, tool schemas, and MCP bridge to the model; that load is not included in the segment estimate above. “Actual” is one call's single-pass input (input + cacheRead + cacheWrite). The CLI reports these counters cumulatively across its internal tool loop, so they are divided by num_turns to calculate per-call context.
context.cliNoteReference: {{provider}} adds its own system prompt, built-in tools, and bridged tool schemas; the segment estimate above does not include this load. No turn has been measured yet, so the expected overhead is projected from the measured reference; actual input appears after the first turn.
context.cliPredicted: Estimate {{estimated}} → expected floor ~{{baseline}} (+{{overhead}} base overhead, not measured yet)

compaction.fits: No additional messages would be folded this turn — the sequence already fits the budget.
compaction.previewHint: This preview applies the persistent summary boundary but does not apply this turn's additional budget folding. Near the budget, the real turn may fold more messages — use “Simulate compaction” above to include it.
compaction.simulated: Compaction simulation is on. This sequence also reflects this turn's budgeted folding (read-only — no new summary was generated or saved).
compaction.wouldFold_one: {{count}} more pending message would be folded into the summary; it appears in orange in the “No longer sent” group below.
compaction.wouldFold_other: {{count}} more pending messages would be folded into the summary; they appear in orange in the “No longer sent” group below.

context.compactionTitle: Simulate this turn's compaction — reduce the message sequence to what the model would actually receive (read-only, does not generate or save a summary)
context.droppedHint: These messages were folded into the summary and are no longer sent to the model verbatim — their contents are represented in the Summary section above. Their tokens are excluded from the total. Retrieve the full text with conversation_search if needed.
context.dynamicCliHint: claude-cli: dynamic context is injected into the final user message, not sent as a separate system block (so the warm cache prefix remains intact).
context.floorNote: “Expected floor” is the LOWER BOUND for the next minimal turn (CLI base + eager tool schemas only). The measured “Actual” may exceed it: the difference is warm context accumulated throughout the session (history retained server-side with --resume, cacheRead on each internal call) plus deferred tools activated at runtime.
context.noFreshMessages: No fresh messages (all are in the cached prefix).
context.samplePlaceholder: Example 'next' user message → what would the context look like if this message were sent?

stat.foldedHint: Folded into the summary — excluded from the total
stat.lazyHint: Schema is not sent with the turn — its cost is in the System segment

context.subtitle: The complete request {{agent}} would receive on the next turn in this session
context.summaryCachedHint: The summary is no longer in volatile Dynamic context; it is sent as a message at the start of the cached prefix (P2) → cache read between folds instead of fresh input every turn.
context.title: Next-turn context preview

tools.cliHint: claude-cli: these tools are delivered through the CLI's built-in tools and MCP bridge, not as schemas in TionHarness's own request; the token count below is approximate (the actual load depends on the CLI's representation — see “CLI overhead” above).
tools.eagerHelp: The FULL schema for these tools (description + JSON input schema + examples) is sent every turn. Expand a tool to inspect it.
tools.lazyCli: The agent reaches them with the CLI's own ToolSearch; tools activated during the session stay warm but are not included in this popup's “Tools” count (schemas sent every turn).
tools.lazyHelp: The schema is not sent with the turn — only the name and summary remain in the system prompt's Available Tools (load on demand) section (token cost is counted under “System”).
tools.lazyNative: The agent activates the desired tool for the next step with activate_tools.
tools.noEager: No tool schemas are sent to this agent.

contextUsage.exceeded: Window exceeded — older turns will be compressed into a summary on the next turn.
contextUsage.summarized_one: The first {{count}} message was folded into the summary (~{{tokens}} tokens).
contextUsage.summarized_other: The first {{count}} messages were folded into the summary (~{{tokens}} tokens).
contextUsage.title: Context window · {{used}}/{{window}} ({{percent}}%)

coordinator.enableNested: Enable coordinator mode (let this worker manage its own workers)

halted.description: The coordinator claimed to start a worker without making a real spawn_worker call; corrective warnings did not help, so automatic turns were stopped. Send a message such as actually call spawn_worker or resume it for one turn below.
halted.title: Coordinator stopped

coordinator.noWorkers: No workers yet. Start parallel workers in chat with spawn_worker.
coordinator.queuedMessage: Pending message: delivered automatically when this turn ends
coordinator.scopeHint: This switch affects this session only. If the agent is configured as a coordinator (Agents ▸ Coordinator), every new session it opens will still start as a coordinator.
coordinator.title: Coordination

tree.empty: This session is not part of a coordinator tree yet.

health.errored: The last turn ended with an error
health.halted: Stopped — phantom spawn; automatic turns stopped and must be resumed
health.stuck: Stuck — autonomous turns are being rejected and intervention is required

tree.queuedMessage: Pending message: delivered when this turn ends
tree.reportPending: Has not closed its report to the coordinator yet
tree.title: Coordinator tree

workerHeader.subCoordinator: This session is a sub-coordinator — it manages its own workers and reports to the coordinator above it. The end of its turn does not mean its work is done; it closes the result with report_to_coordinator.
workerHeader.worker: This session is a worker — it was started by a coordinator. Its result is delivered to the coordinator session as a <task-notification>.

hooks.description: Hooks fired in this session, attributed by hook (including rtk/sqz): how often and for which tool. This indicates activity, not byte savings (_Docs/17).
hooks.empty: No hook firings in this session's native turns. Note: hooks run inside the CLI on claude-cli turns and are not recorded here.
hooks.nativeOnly: Only native turns are counted (claude-cli turns run inside the CLI).
hooks.optimizerHelp: rtk/sqz rewrites commands to reduce output; TionHarness cannot see the uncompressed size, so this shows activity only, not byte savings.
hooks.optimizerInactive: The token optimizer hook (rtk/sqz) did not fire in this session.
hooks.title: Hook / token optimizer activity

promptCache.empty: No prompt-cache events in this session (healthy: the cache is working quietly).
promptCache.help: Lifecycle of the frozen context snapshot (freeze, adopt, held drift, manual refresh; 57-PROMPT-EPOCH) and detected cache breaks — a break is expected only at a deliberate adopt.
promptCache.title: Prompt-cache events

sankey.empty: No tool calls in this session.
sankey.help: Call flow from agent to tool; band width is proportional to call count, with a separate error branch when present.
sankey.title: Tool execution flow (Sankey)

selfHealing.empty: No self-healing events in this session (healthy).

selfHealing.title: Self-healing events

thinking.description: Estimated share of output tokens spent on hidden reasoning per call (the API does not separate it → derived from output minus visible; _Docs/38). A high share on simple tasks is an opportunity to lower ThinkingLevel.
thinking.empty: No measurable hidden reasoning in this session (a thinking-off agent is silent).
thinking.help: Each bar is one LLM call; height = the share of that call's output spent on thinking.
thinking.title: Thinking (hidden reasoning) share

timeline.empty: Not enough events for a timeline.
timeline.help: Events on a time axis in one lane per agent; overlap between lanes shows real concurrency.
timeline.title: Concurrency timeline
